NIfTI Saving¶

neurora.nii_save

Function Index¶

  • save_nii

API Details¶

a module for saving the RSA results in a .nii file for fMRI

neurora.nii_save.save_nii(results, affine, filename=None, corr_mask='/Users/zitonglu/Documents/Projects/NeuroRA-master/neurora/template/HarvardOxford-cort-maxprob-thr0-1mm.nii.gz', size=(60, 60, 60), ksize=(3, 3, 3), strides=(1, 1, 1), p=0.05, value_threshold=None, correct_method=None, nvoxels_threshold=None, smooth=True, plotrlt=True, img_background=None, plot_type='r', colorbar_label=None)¶

Save fMRI RSA searchlight results as a NIfTI file.

Parameters:

  • results (array_like, shape [n_x, n_y, n_z, 2]) –

    Searchlight results.

    The last dimension contains:

    • results[…, 0] : value map, such as r-values or t-values

    • results[…, 1] : p-values

  • affine (array_like, shape [4, 4]) – NIfTI affine matrix.

  • filename (str or None, default=None) –

    Output NIfTI filename.

    If None, “rsa_result.nii” will be used.

  • corr_mask (str or None, default=get_HOcort()) –

    Mask filename.

    If None, no mask will be applied.

  • size (tuple or list of int, default=(60, 60, 60)) – Target image size [nx, ny, nz].

  • ksize (tuple or list of int, default=(3, 3, 3)) – Searchlight kernel size [kx, ky, kz].

  • strides (tuple or list of int, default=(1, 1, 1)) – Searchlight strides [sx, sy, sz].

  • p (float, default=0.05) – P-value threshold.

  • value_threshold (float or None, default=None) –

    Optional threshold for values.

    For correlation maps, this can be used as an r-value threshold. For statistical maps, this is usually None.

  • correct_method ({None, "FWE", "FDR"}, default=None) –

    Multiple-comparison correction method.

    • None : no p-value correction

    • ”FWE” : Bonferroni FWE correction

    • ”FDR” : Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction

  • nvoxels_threshold (int or None, default=None) –

    Minimum cluster size in voxels.

    If not None, small clusters in the final volume will be removed using correct_by_threshold().

  • smooth (bool, default=True) – Whether to smooth the output NIfTI image.

  • plotrlt (bool, default=True) – Whether to plot the result automatically.

  • img_background (str or None, default=None) – Background image filename used for plotting.

  • plot_type ({"r", "t"}, default="r") – Plot type passed to plot_brainrsa_rlts.

  • colorbar_label (str or None, default=None) – Colorbar label. Reserved for future plot_brainrsa_rlts support.

Returns:

volume – Saved result volume before smoothing.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [nx, ny, nz]
